content: Older mobile users experience reduced contrast sensitivity, color perception, near-focus, dexterity, fine motor control, and short-term memory. W3C WAI guidance recommends large controls, high contrast, clear layout, readable text, and consistent feedback. Mobile game design principles emphasize short sessions, clear goals, large touch targets, responsive controls, and accessible onboarding. For Mahjong specifically, tile readability (distinct symbols, large size, color/shape differentiation) and low-pressure modes are critical.
